## 2. Data Flow Diagram (DFD Level 1)
*Breaks down the core system into major functional processes.*

```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph External Actors
        DEL((Delegate))
        UMP((Umpire))
    end
    
    subgraph Processes
        P1((1.0 Manage Blueprint))
        P2((2.0 Generate Draws))
        P3((3.0 Score Processing))
        P4((4.0 Audit & Archival))
    end
    
    subgraph Data Stores
        D1[(Tournaments DB)]
        D2[(Players DB)]
        D3[(Matches DB)]
        D4[(Audit Ledger)]
    end
    
    DEL -->|Create Config| P1
    P1 -->|Store Meta| D1
    
    DEL -->|Trigger Engine| P2
    D2 -->|Registered Players| P2
    P2 -->|Generate Bracket Nodes| D3
    
    UMP -->|Live Score Mutations| P3
    P3 -->|Update Node State| D3
    P3 -->|Log Mutation| D4
    
    P3 -->|Evaluate Completion| P4
    P4 -->|Lock Volatile Data| D3
    P4 -->|Seal Ledger| D4
```

## 3. Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD Domain Model)
*Conceptual mapping of the relational constraints.*

```mermaid
erDiagram
    TOURNAMENT {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        enum status "INIT, PRE, LIVE, ARCHIVED"
        jsonb config "Format, Categories"
    }
    
    CATEGORY {
        uuid id PK
        uuid tournament_id FK
        string type "MENS_SINGLES, WOMENS_DOUBLES"
    }

    PLAYER {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        int itf_ranking
    }
    
    REGISTRATION {
        uuid player_id FK
        uuid category_id FK
        int manual_seed
        boolean fee_paid
    }
    
    MATCH {
        uuid id PK
        uuid category_id FK
        uuid player1_id FK
        uuid player2_id FK
        int round "32, 16, 8, 4, 2"
        jsonb score_state "Points, Sets, Games"
        enum status "PENDING, ACTIVE, CONCLUDED"
    }
    
    AUDIT_LOG {
        uuid id PK
        uuid tournament_id FK
        string action_type
        jsonb payload
        timestamp created_at
    }

    TOURNAMENT ||--o{ CATEGORY : contains
    CATEGORY ||--o{ MATCH : constructs
    CATEGORY ||--o{ REGISTRATION : has
    PLAYER ||--o{ REGISTRATION : submits
    MATCH }o--|| PLAYER : contested_by
    TOURNAMENT ||--o{ AUDIT_LOG : tracks
```
